title: MysteryMerchant
description: This is a mysterious merchant, text and translation can be configured in plugin.yml. The plugin is in beta testing, if you find a bug, please contact me by email - nuxionse@outlook.com
body:
MysteryMerchant is a universal plugin for Minecraft servers (compatible with versions 1.17.1–1.21) that adds a unique Mystery Merchant to the map. The merchant appears in a random safe place in the world, except for prohibited regions, and disappears after a specified time. The plugin supports purchasing items for EssentialsX/Vault currency, purchase limits configured via config.yml, and bright visual effects: particles, a loud spawn sound for all players, an attractive chat message with clickable coordinates for teleportation (for OP), and a boss bar with a timer until despawn. After despawning, the limits are reset, and buggy merchants are automatically removed when the server is restarted. Localization files are created in the language folder for easy translation. MysteryMerchant is the perfect solution for organizing events, trading, and increasing player activity on your server!


Dependencies:
- [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)
- Economy Plugin (Essentials, XConomy, etc...)
- [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) (Optional)

Commands list:
 - /mmspawn - Trader spawn manual
- /mmremove - Trader remove manual
- /mmresetlimits - Reset trader limits manual

- 🐛 **How to Report Issues**
If you encounter any issues or errors, please create an issue on the project's GitHub page or contact the plugin author directly. Be sure to include your server version, plugin version, and a detailed description of the issue.
